name: Tree Fellers
tagline: Fully insured, vetted tree felling experts offering safe extraction and digital payment.
hook_headline: Remove the risk, not just the tree.
hook_body: A dead tree threatening your roof is a massive liability. But hiring a 'cash only' team off the street without insurance is an even bigger one. If they drop a branch on your house, you're paying for it. Bouul connects you only with vetted tree fellers. Verify their credentials, agree on a price, and protect your funds in escrow until the tree is gone and the rubble is cleared.
pains: Cowboy operators demanding cash but holding no liability insurance.
Bouul allows you to verify credentials and protects your payment in escrow if damage occurs.
Teams felling the tree but leaving massive piles of branches behind.
In-app quoting clearly specifies rubble removal, ensuring the job is finished properly.
Dangerous operations putting your family and property at risk.
Read reviews from real users specifically praising safety protocols and clean-up.
audience: Estates needing routine, safe canopy management
why_bodies: Real reviews ensure contractors don't get away with property damage or leaving a mess behind.
Release funds only when the tree is safely down and all refuse has been cleared from your property.
Send a picture of the tree and access constraints so the team arrives with the right equipment.
trust: Digital escrow prevents cash extortion on site
Verification of identity for all site workers
Platform accountability prevents hit-and-run property damage
faqs: Will they remove the wood and branches?
Yes, you can specifically request 'felling and refuse removal' in the app to ensure your quote covers full clean-up.
Can they remove the stump too?
Stump grinding is a separate specialized service that many of our vetted professionals offer. You can request this in your initial brief.
